visual_observations.observation: A person is lying on their back, covered with a maroon towel. Another person is performing a treatment on their abdomen. A dough ring is placed around the navel, and a hand is pouring oil into the ring.
Close-up of the dough ring around the navel, filled with oil.
A hand is stirring the oil within the dough ring on the navel.
The dough ring has been removed, and a hand is massaging oil into the abdomen around the navel.
A black herbal pouch is being pressed and massaged onto the oiled abdomen.
A hand is massaging the oiled abdomen with circular motions.
The black herbal pouch is again being pressed and massaged onto the oiled abdomen.
A hand is massaging the oiled abdomen with broad strokes.
